description: This file defines a `TokenService` class that handles issuing and parsing JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) for authentication purposes within a Spring Boot application. It manages secret key generation, signing tokens with claims, and validating incoming tokens.

classes.name: TokenService
classes.description: Service class responsible for issuing and verifying JWTs. It generates a secret key either from an environment variable or a default byte array, and provides methods to create signed tokens with claims and validate incoming tokens.

methods.name: TokenService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the secret key for signing JWTs. Uses environment variable JWT_SECRET if provided, otherwise generates a default key for development.

methods.name: issueToken
methods.description: Creates and signs a JWT with the specified subject, time-to-live, and additional claims.

methods.name: parseAndValidate
methods.description: Parses and validates a JWT, returning the claims if valid, or throwing an exception if invalid or expired.
